scope: Frontend graph and saved compaction event metadata; ExMekh-Lib and its bundled wheel are unchanged

behavior.label: Context compaction
behavior.details: One runtime event, including operation identity, replacement IDs, scope, timestamp and execution boundary; no fabricated tool execution stages
behavior.batching: One applied operation produces one point even when it replaces multiple history blocks
behavior.ordering: Place after the last completed invocation or synthetic replacement at application time, preserving preceding accepted guidance and placing the point before resumed work
behavior.new_turn: Retain saved events on earlier messages and clear only the new turn's event list; compaction of previous context is shown before new work
behavior.scopes: Root, nested skills and observed child conversations retain independent metadata and graph positions
behavior.persistence: Optional compactions list in ModelContextCheckpoint; metadata does not enter the model's request history

compatibility: Existing chats without operation metadata display their available compact_history markers as dedicated points, without invented execution records or timestamps; several old markers cannot reliably be grouped into their original operation.
The graph retains its existing rendering lifecycle: final response completion produces the full graph. The transient compaction progress bar remains in the response area while the operation runs.
Only successfully applied replacements create persistent compaction events. Failed attempts retain the existing execution error node.
No changes to model requests, scoring, inference kernels or server protocols.
